An event filled week that affected markets. 
- Tuesday , news of lower than expected debt. MSFT GOOG AMD reported with sell off reactions. 
- Wednesday, FOMC caused a volatile reaction going up then selling off sharply. NYBC big sell off after news of trouble after acquiring troubled bank assets last year.

- Friday, market gap up pre market. Then jobs report had strong numbers, cooling off the gap. Yet AI infra names went up a lot on AMZN comments on upgrading their capabilities. Even GOOG and AAPL had strong reclaim candles on volume while AMZN and META held their big gaps. NVDA AMD CRWD had strong continuation breakouts. There’s no arguing with price, it’s a bull market!

What an incredibly frustrating market to trade this week. The overall trend of money into mega caps has not changed, with everything else not really working. The large caps were tested on FOMC day but reclaimed swiftly. 

Best opportunities this week
- NXT UEC AFRM short, PTON short 
- SNOW MNDY
- FATE EYPT 
- FUBO ELF MDB
- Not sure if these will follow through. 
- Opportunity set much worse then 2 weeks ago 

My own trading 
- it is no surprise that for the entire week, my strategy was to not take breakouts and only take EPs, it I struggled to adhere to that plan.
- A large takeaway is ofcourse to be very careful around major economic and reporting events. My previous objective was to not wait for strong EPs before taking subsequent ones. I have done this but perhaps gone too far. Be cautious of other external events.

Author: dolivent
Content:
The main narrative this week was the bounce that everyone was expecting. Objectively, we could have expected a 3-5 day bounce, but we got 1-2 days. Underlying stocks haven't been setting up, and we don't have higher lows forming like we see in the best stocks that show RS before they go on big runs. TQQQ, TSLA and PLTR main focus for vehicle selection here since the  entire market is correlated. 

Some EPs have offered daytrades, or at least breakeven stops for swing traders testing waters. Earnings season starts in 2 weeks. The selloff increaes odds of good reactions. SURG SLNO

Mid-week, we saw the resurrection of small caps, which largely operate independently from the indexes. DATS VVPR MLGO. Failed but active DJT GME

China was one of the two strong sectors (other being gold) that has showing some signs of distirbution. Tech/semis are leaking off while biotech and "value" stocks like banks are going up. This looks more like rotation than a selloff. Expecting dicrepencies between ADR and HK session trading because of cross border flow impacts (US traders seeking RS in china stocks or US traders selling draging down ADR linked stocks in HK session. 

The exception is in gold names. We saw the rest as growth stocks attempted the bounce, but gapped up as it seemed like the entire world was selling equities to buy gold. SAND HMY AU

On Friday, we got stagflationary data and sold off accordingly (bad news, bad price action). We are still in a downtrend and sentiment is changing very quickly, constantly. Main toolkit im looking to is weekly timeframes to smooth the general trend/reduce anxiety and also News Failures (after prolonged selling, bad news + good price action = potential turn). 

.

Author: dolivent
Content:
Small caps: MLGO ICCT 
IPO: **CRWV ** NMAX
Swing Short: **SOXX ** PLTR 
Random BO: RCAT

Best opps were CRWV and SOXX.

CRWV had a lot of people talking, especially on the pessimistic side. There was significant volatility in sentiment: it was one of the hottest IPOs in recent times, yet rumors of IPO price being cut in half one day prior, followed by NVDA anchoring at 40 as deadline neared. As we’ve seen with PLTR a few years ago, when stocks are widely debated, that can become potential fuel for a move. A simple entry, like a break of the previous day’s highs, would have worked well. Breaking news came after the entry, with Sam Altman (OpenAI/ChatGPT) emphasizing a shortage in exactly what CRWV offers. The exit could have been an intraday break of the range (or short)

SOXX on Thursday was essentially an EP  on some of the most significant news... possibly ever. We’ve been in a downtrend for a while now, and this was pretty much confirmed when we lost the 200-day moving average a few weeks ago—not to mention the sheer lack of setups. Time and again, where price should have held, it didn’t, further underscoring the downtrend. Just as in bull markets, when things go straight up, in this case, when things go straight down, you can get paid for breaking the rules a little. Here, that would mean chasing the gap down in SOXX. If the chart were inverted, it would be a perfectly good long setup. Of course, all this is being said with the benefit of hindsight and its very hard to execute without considering the context and significance of the news.

Tuesday: reclaim of previous week lows was an expectation breaker to me. Combined with NFLX MSTR BTC higher from breakout and GLD down signals shift in risk + Trump sentiment shift on China talks. During sentiment shifts, theres usually a choppy period where entry tactics dont work yet ,if stock selection is good, the stock ends up higher. Also a technical FTD which has a 50% chance to work. Very frustrating if trying to get positioned, but its a good sign. 

Wednesday: gold down bitcoin up plus change in china tariff sentiment causes big gap up over entire market. I got sucked in but Bessent and Trump reversed the picture and we left the session with the exact inverse (gold up tarrif sentiment down etc). If bought Tues, plenty of cushion for the inevitable pullback.

Thursday: expectation breaker day after poor action yest. Big growth NOW EP + 200day reclaim, NFLX double top breakout. GEV through TSLA highs. Speculative weed + quantum names strong. Market up despite bad news Russian launches a massive attack on Ukraine and China states that reports of trade progress between it and the U.S. is nothing more than fake news. Can see a path forward where earnings gives us more leadership names and market starts to brush off crazy Trump headlines.

Friday: Day 3 of move. lots of chasing which is good but short term extension? TSLA through ER range. Price could pull back from here, stop out entries from past 2 days, and charts would look perfectly healthy.
